title: Windows Hello PIN minimum length is short

report.title: Windows Hello PIN minimum is {Items.Count} characters

messages.businessImpact: A four digit PIN protects a credential that unlocks company data. The device lockout helps, but the margin is thinner than it needs to be.
remediation: Raise the minimum PIN length to six or more.
messages.cannotSee: The minimum length is one property of many. A tenant requiring uppercase, digits or symbols has a stronger credential than the length alone suggests, and this does not weigh that.
